paper.title: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
paper.central_claim: 稀疏奖励的网页 RL 任务里，用 demonstration 诱导出的“workflow”（逐步的元素/动作类型约束 lattice）约束探索，让环境盲的 workflow policy 先发现奖励，再用成功 episode 训练表达力更强的 DOMnet 神经策略；在 MiniWoB/MiniWoB++/Alaska 上取得 SOTA，demonstration 样本效率较行为克隆高 >100x（abstract 原话 “more than 100x”）。

provenance.independence_note: Aggregation over two seat inputs; the fixed paper text was read in full before the seat scores, but this is not a third blind review or human gold. All results are author reports; nothing was reproduced.

sections_read: full text, all sections and appendices as rendered

materials.visual_asset_caveat: Text render contains captions and tables; plotted/diagrammed images were not independently viewed. Unrendered numerical values are not inferred.

preliminary_evidence_judgment: Read before seat scores. WGE induces demonstration-consistent workflow lattices (abstract click/type constraints), learns an environment-blind distribution over workflow steps with REINFORCE, stores reward(+1) episodes in a replay buffer and trains a DOM-structured neural policy (DOMnet) with A2C on-policy + replay. Evidence: MiniWoB programmatic rewards (interactive, executable checker) on a self-selected 40/80 task subset; main 40-task results only in Fig 3 (caption in render), Table 1 for 11 tasks; Alaska is a ported clone with surrogate backend and partial reward. The cleanest control is DOMnet+BC+RL vs DOMnet+WGE (same net, same 10 demos), but the BC+RL arm is not described as using the positive-episode replay buffer, and there is no pure-RL / uniform-workflow / no-constraint exploration arm, so 'workflows prune exploration' is not isolated from 'replay of rewarded episodes'. No seeds/CIs, no test-episode counts. Checkpoint chosen on validation, evaluated on test instances. Applicable cards: sparse-reward RL with replay (K20), element-id DOM actions (C01); E03/E16/E19/E34 time-equivalents.

scope_decision.reason: Web-interface agent acting on DOM elements (click/type) in interactive MiniWoB environments; training method for the policy.

signatures.object: 稀疏奖励下的探索策略（相对基线：BC 预训练 + RL 微调）
signatures.information: demonstration（每任务 3–10 条，含 DOM 状态序列与动作）；goal 为结构化键值或自然语言；workflow policy 训练时需读取结构化 goal（特权信息，神经策略测试时只看自然语言）；不使用环境状态。
signatures.operation: 对每条 demo 枚举每步所有满足 a~_t∈z_t(s~_t) 的 workflow step，得到 lattice（带 shortcut 步以容忍噪声 demo）；π_w 先按 goal 键相似度选 demo，再逐步采样 workflow step（环境盲，参数 ψ_{z,t,d} 用 REINFORCE 训练），最后在 z_t(s_t) 内均匀采样具体动作。
signatures.output: workflow 约束下的 episode；+1 奖励 episode 进入 replay buffer；神经策略 π_n 用 A2C 做 on-policy + replay off-policy 更新。
signatures.conditions: 动作空间受限为 Click/Type；约束语言有限(Appendix A)；奖励仅在 episode 末给出；goal 需有结构化形式供 π_w 使用。
signatures.feedback: 末端奖励 ±1（Alaska 例外有部分奖励）。
signatures.selection_rule: 只有 reward=+1 的 episode 进入 buffer；检查点按验证集成功率最高选取。
signatures.selection_data: 训练环境实例（随机种子生成），验证集成功率用于选 checkpoint，测试集独立。
signatures.persistence: replay buffer（单次训练内）、ψ 参数与 π_n 权重；无跨任务、跨站点保存。
signatures.later_use: 同一任务的新随机实例上的测试 episode；不存在跨任务复用。
signatures.claimed_effect: 长程/稀疏奖励任务显著优于 BC+RL（Table 1），Alaska 1 demo 平均奖励 0.97 vs Shi17 0.57(~80 demos)，>100x demonstration 效率。
signatures.failure_boundary: π_w 单独无法解 multi-layout(9%)；约束语言无同义词；social-media-all=0；click-checkboxes-transfer 无增益；依赖结构化 goal；仅 40/80 MiniWoB 任务。

retained_trace.reason: 静态训练方法研究，不声称自我改进/跨任务留存；此处 replay buffer 仅是同次训练内的选择性数据缓存，“修改前=BC+RL → 候选=workflow 约束 episode → 选择=+1 奖励 → 持久化=buffer/权重 → 后续=同任务测试实例 → 增益=Table 1”可追踪，但不构成 retained improvement 声称。

signatures.object: 神经策略 π_n 的 DOM 编码器（DOMnet，对比 Shi17 主要用像素）
signatures.information: 完整 DOM 树（元素标签、class、文本等）+ goal 的键值或 token；30px 内空间邻居、深度 k=3..6 的树邻居、goal 匹配词。
signatures.operation: 每个元素 = [base; spatial neighbors; tree neighbors; goal-match] 拼接嵌入，再对 goal/DOM 做多层注意力，输出元素分布、字符串选择、动作类型。
signatures.output: 策略 π_n(a|s) 与价值 V(s)。
signatures.conditions: 有可读 DOM；叶子元素动作。
signatures.feedback: A2C 梯度（来自 buffer 与 on-policy 回报）。
signatures.claimed_effect: DOMnet+BC+RL 相对 Shi17 “大多数任务提升”（Figure 3，数值仅图中）。
signatures.failure_boundary: 与 Shi17 比较时观测(像素 vs DOM)与演示量都不同，无法分离架构贡献；未做 DOMnet 各部件的 ablation。

gap.author_gap: 稀疏、延迟奖励且动作空间巨大时，RL 探索几乎找不到成功序列；BC 预热会在状态多样的网站上过拟合，Shi17 报告 BC 预热常不优于纯 RL。
gap.checked_gap: 文内证据部分支持：同架构下 BC+RL 在长程任务上 0–15%（EV13/EV17），且有可观察的失败模式（提前提交、循环点击，EV19）。但“纯 RL/Shi17 无法学习”主要靠引用（EV02/EV29），本文未自行复现纯 RL 基线；BC 失败原因仅为 “one likely cause”。

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Interactive MiniWoB environments with programmatic per-task reward; same task families for training and test (new random instances), Alaska is a port, so not transfer.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, single selection-on-validation run: on a 40/80 action-compatible MiniWoB subset and MiniWoB++ tasks, DOMnet trained with workflow-guided exploration plus rewarded-episode replay greatly exceeds the same DOMnet trained with BC+RL from the same 10 demos on long-horizon sparse tasks (e.g. 0->84, 5->100, 15->100 in Table 1); the workflow policy alone is insufficient. That the workflow constraint (rather than replay of any rewarded episodes) is the active ingredient, the real-website claim, and the >100x efficiency in total cost are not established.
not_supported: General SOTA on MiniWoB (subset chosen by action-space compatibility; main per-task values figure-only in our render)
Real-website competence (Alaska is a ported clone with surrogate backend)
>100x efficiency beyond demonstration count (environment interaction and compute not reported)
unresolved: Whether the BC+RL arm used a positive-episode replay buffer (agg:W-A01)
assessment.retention_trace: Not a retained-improvement claim: rewarded episodes are training data for the neural policy; no accepted/rejected modification persists across tasks.

G.reason: Concrete sparse-reward/BC-overfitting bottleneck, sourced (Shi17) and partly reproduced in-paper by BC+RL failure modes; lineage (BC warm-start, demo-guided shaping/off-policy, HAM partial policies, constraint learning) named with explicit operational differences; residual limits of the workflow policy stated. Not 4: nearest originals are author-attributed only and the pure-RL failure premise is cited, not tested.

M.reason: Environment-blind action-class constraints shrink exploration while keeping the expressive policy away from direct imitation; the explanation is reconstructable and predicts the observed BC+RL failure modes. No distinguishing ablation (random/uniform constraints).

X.reason: Lattice induction, constraint language (App. A), REINFORCE workflow policy, +1 replay, A2C on/off-policy and DOMnet are specified; buffer size, replay ratio, training steps and baseline v are not.

E.measurement.reason: Programmatic MiniWoB rewards are executable checkers and partial rewards were disabled for consistency; deductions: test-episode counts not given, main 40-task values figure-only in the fixed render, Alaska uses a surrogate backend with partial reward, no checker audit (E13).

E.causality.reason: Same-net same-demo DOMnet+BC+RL vs DOMnet+WGE is the key control and pi_w-only adds mechanism evidence, but WGE additionally trains from a replay buffer of rewarded episodes that the BC+RL arm is not described as using, and there is no pure-RL, uniform-workflow or no-constraint exploration arm; Shi17 comparison mixes observation and demo count. The workflow constraint is therefore not isolated (anchor 2).

E.holdout.reason: Checkpoint selected on validation, tested on fresh random instances, unseen NL utterances; but same task families, transfer variant shows no gain, subset self-selected, Alaska port presented as real.

E.statistics.reason: Single selected value per task, no seeds, spreads or test-episode counts; qualitative failure modes only.

E.cost.reason: Only demonstration counts are budgeted (10 vs up to 1000); environment interactions, wall-clock and compute not reported, so the >100x efficiency is demonstration-only.

status_reason: Full fixed HTML text available and read (figure images are captions only); in scope per scope_decision; all eight items resolved.

resolutions.reason: The load-bearing operation is generate (workflow-constrained explorer) -> gate (environment +1) -> retrain (DOMnet on replay), matching the C08 skeleton partially. relax_discrete_search_to_continuous concerns jointly optimising a hand-engineered design structure; the workflow distribution is an exploration policy, and sol assigned no child for it.
C08 partial (gate is true reward; no gate/constraint ablation); C13 supporting is shared by both seats.

sol's 2 rests only on the historical originals being outside the fixed pack; both seats treat lineage as author-attributed. The paper itself gives a sourced, in-paper-reproduced bottleneck, named lineage with explicit operational differences and stated residuals, which meets anchor 3; inability to read 2017-and-earlier originals is a material limitation, not a gap defect.
